sections.heading: Arc Doctrine
sections.body: Every New Moon plants seeds revealed six months later at the same-sign Full Moon. Track both the two-week immediate arc and the six-month maturation arc. Always name both.

sections.heading: Complete Axis Themes
sections.body: Use axis work to name shared themes, differences, shadows, integration point, and Full Moon opportunity.

items.label: Aries / Libra
items.body: Self vs. Others. Core tension: independence vs. partnership. Integration question: Can you stand fully in yourself while still making room for someone else? Shadow work includes times you kept the peace but lost yourself, or pushed people away in the name of independence.

items.label: Taurus / Scorpio
items.body: Security vs. Transformation. Core tension: stability vs. change. Integration question: Can you create stability in your life that also leaves room for change? Shadow work includes staying too long because it felt safe, or blowing everything up because stability felt suffocating.

items.label: Gemini / Sagittarius
items.body: Information vs. Wisdom. Core tension: details vs. big picture. Integration question: Can you stay curious without getting lost in details, and share insights without oversimplifying them? Shadow work includes avoiding decisions by asking endless questions, or clinging to a belief so tightly you stopped listening.

items.label: Cancer / Capricorn
items.body: Nurturing vs. Achievement. Core tension: emotional safety vs. public success. Integration question: Can you build success without sacrificing the people and peace that matter most, and care for home life without retreating from the world? Shadow work includes avoiding challenges in the name of self-care, or pursuing success at the expense of well-being.

items.label: Leo / Aquarius
items.body: Personal expression vs. collective good. Core tension: standing out vs. belonging. Integration question: Can you shine without making it all about you, and contribute to the group without disappearing in the crowd? Shadow work includes shaping yourself to be accepted, or withdrawing to prove you do not need anyone.

items.label: Virgo / Pisces
items.body: Precision vs. Flow. Core tension: control vs. surrender. Integration question: Can you give your all without losing yourself, and loosen your grip without letting go of the vision? Shadow work includes fixating on details to avoid uncertainty, or drifting into fantasy to avoid reality.

sections.heading: Double New Moon System
sections.body: When two New Moons occur in the same sign about 29.5 days apart, the lesson is emphasized as non-negotiable. First New Moon at 0-3 degrees: this is the first of two New Moons and a chance to go deeper. Second New Moon at 27-29 degrees: review what began four weeks ago and see how the attempt can grow into a higher expression or slip into shadow.

items.label: Earth Signs

items.label: Water Signs

sections.heading: Eclipse Protocol
sections.body: Eclipse Witness: Stop. Put down candles, crystals, and kameas. If something must be done, light one white candle. Journal what is actually moving through you: what is ending, changing, or being removed. Eclipses take what is expired and give what is needed. The most powerful magick is knowing when not to interfere.

sections.heading: Major Aspect Patterns
sections.body: Use these patterns when writing major planetary aspects.

items.label: Conjunction
items.body: 0 degrees. Planet 1 meets Planet 2 in a sign. This is fusion: one planet's quality merges with the other's quality, creating something neither could achieve alone.

items.label: Square
items.body: 90 degrees. Planet 1 in Sign 1 squares Planet 2 in Sign 2. The tension shows competing approaches. Neither is wrong; both are necessary. The friction creates breakthrough through a third way.

items.label: Opposition
items.body: 180 degrees. Planet 1 opposes Planet 2. The person is pulled between two qualities. This is not about choosing sides; it is about finding the bridge and holding both.

items.label: Trine
items.body: 120 degrees. Planet 1 in Sign 1 trines Planet 2 in Sign 2. When signs align by element, quality flows with less effort. Notice what feels easier and do not overthink the gift.

sections.heading: Retrograde Daily Guidance Framework
sections.body: Use daily guidance to identify the pattern becoming visible, not to force action.

items.label: Mercury Retrograde
items.body: 21-24 days. Focus on communication patterns, mental loops, technology issues, travel delays, and unfinished conversations returning. Notice where communication patterns have been operating on autopilot.

items.label: Venus Retrograde
items.body: 40-43 days. Focus on worth patterns, relationship dynamics, financial decisions, beauty ideals, and self-care versus indulgence. Notice where undervaluing yourself or compromising too quickly shapes connection, spending, creation, and care.

items.label: Mars Retrograde
items.body: 58-81 days. Focus on anger patterns, energy management, action versus reaction, boundaries, and initiative versus force. Let anger be messenger, not driver.
